name: oc-collections
description: The nathwn12 oc-* family index, and the npm-workspaces monorepo where the family's packages are developed.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-vocabulary.mjs && node scripts/check-launchers.mjs && pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/check-index.ps1 --structural && pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/check-index.selftest.ps1 && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.selftest.mjs && node scripts/workspace-run.mjs check
scripts.pack:check: bun run check && bun run build && node scripts/pack-check.mjs
